Designs sustainable generosity practices that align personal values with meaningful giving.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Generosity Practice Designer.

- Helps users identify their natural generosity style and align giving practices with personal values.
- Includes tools to distinguish genuine vs. performative generosity and address guilt or obligation-based giving.
- Guides creation of sustainable, meaningful generosity practices based on individual motivation and resources.
- Offers reflection prompts and tips to prevent burnout and deepen generosity practice.
- Designed for all income levels; covers five “generosity languages” beyond just financial giving.
